name: Ace of Wands
thoth_title: Root of the Powers of Fire
gd_title: Root of the Powers of Fire
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Kether is the undivided root of Wands. Study the element in potential before assigning it a particular situation; the Ace does not inherit a decan from the numbered cards.

name: 2 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Mars supplies directed initiative to Chokmah’s outpouring in Fire; Aries reinforces beginning and assertion. Dominion names the act of establishing a direction.

name: 3 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Binah gives the impulse a form; the Sun in Aries emphasizes a coherent, active expression. Virtue here can be studied as effective power, not merely moral goodness.

name: 4 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chesed establishes a stable fiery order. Venus in Aries adds attraction to initiative, suggesting a completed arrangement that can support further action.

name: 5 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Geburah introduces testing and restriction into Fire. Saturn constrains Leo’s expressive force, so Strife can be understood as energetic pressure meeting resistance.

name: 6 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Tiphareth centers and reconciles Fire; Jupiter expands Leo’s expression. Victory names a temporary coherence of directed power.

name: 7 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Netzach’s persistence expresses itself through Fire, while Mars in Leo stresses bold assertion. Valour suggests maintaining an effort when harmony is no longer assured.

name: 8 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Hod formulates Fire into a directed pattern. Mercury in Sagittarius emphasizes rapid transmission toward a goal, providing a route to the title Swiftness.

name: 9 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Yesod supplies a sustaining pattern to Fire. The Moon in Sagittarius introduces fluctuation within aspiration, making Strength a question of resilient continuity.

name: 10 of Wands
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Malkuth takes Fire into its full outward expression. Saturn in Sagittarius restricts its movement, suggesting force burdened by its own material demands.

name: Ace of Cups
thoth_title: Root of the Powers of Water
gd_title: Root of the Powers of Water
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Kether is the undivided root of Cups. Study the element in potential before assigning it a particular situation; the Ace does not inherit a decan from the numbered cards.

name: 2 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chokmah gives Water its first movement toward another. Venus in Cancer combines attraction with containment, supporting the theme of Love.

name: 3 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Binah gives Water a generative container. Mercury in Cancer articulates that fecundity into many expressions, suggesting Abundance.

name: 4 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chesed stabilizes Water, and the Moon in Cancer deepens the enclosed receptive condition. Luxury asks when enjoyment becomes too settled.

name: 5 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Geburah disturbs Water’s continuity. Mars in Scorpio intensifies the disruption, providing a route to Disappointment rather than undisturbed pleasure.

name: 6 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Tiphareth brings Water into proportion; the Sun in Scorpio illuminates its transforming depth. Pleasure names an experience with a coherent center.

name: 7 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Netzach amplifies attraction within Water. Venus in Scorpio can intensify desire beyond proportion, making Debauch a question of excess rather than a verdict on a person.

name: 8 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Hod attempts to organize Water, while Saturn in Pisces checks its movement. Indolence suggests a receptive field that no longer circulates readily.

name: 9 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Yesod gathers Water into a sustaining image. Jupiter in Pisces enlarges its receptivity, supporting Happiness as a condition of felt fulfillment.

name: 10 of Cups
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Malkuth completes Water’s manifestation. Mars in Pisces adds an active disturbance to that fullness; Satiety asks what happens after a capacity has been filled.

name: Ace of Swords
thoth_title: Root of the Powers of Air
gd_title: Root of the Powers of Air
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Kether is the undivided root of Swords. Study the element in potential before assigning it a particular situation; the Ace does not inherit a decan from the numbered cards.

name: 2 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chokmah begins differentiation in Air. The Moon in Libra suggests a changing balance between terms, so Peace is a held relationship rather than permanent stillness.

name: 3 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Binah gives Air a limiting form. Saturn in Libra sharpens the experience of separation and necessity, providing a route to Sorrow.

name: 4 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chesed stabilizes Air’s divisions. Jupiter in Libra expands the possibility of accommodation; Truce names a workable pause in conflict.

name: 5 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Geburah cuts within Air’s already dividing activity. Venus in Aquarius introduces attraction into this unstable contest, inviting study of how harmony can fail: Defeat.

name: 6 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Tiphareth coordinates Air into a centered relation. Mercury in Aquarius supports clear formulation across a wider pattern, explaining Science as ordered understanding.

name: 7 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Netzach’s desires complicate Air’s distinctions. The Moon in Aquarius introduces shifting aims; Futility asks whether divided intentions can sustain one effort.

name: 8 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Hod multiplies Air’s own analytic activity. Jupiter in Gemini expands the number of competing directions, offering a route to Interference.

name: 9 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Yesod consolidates Air into a recurring pattern. Mars in Gemini can make that pattern cutting and repetitive, providing a symbolic basis for Cruelty.

name: 10 of Swords
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Malkuth takes Air’s dividing work to its material limit. The Sun in Gemini exposes a completed division, suggesting Ruin as the exhaustion of that pattern.

name: Ace of Disks
thoth_title: Root of the Powers of Earth
gd_title: Root of the Powers of Earth
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Kether is the undivided root of Disks. Study the element in potential before assigning it a particular situation; the Ace does not inherit a decan from the numbered cards.

name: 2 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chokmah sets Earth into motion. Jupiter in Capricorn combines enlargement with structured material conditions; Change is the ongoing balancing of resources.

name: 3 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Binah gives Earth an organized form. Mars in Capricorn supplies directed labor, making Works the construction of a durable result.

name: 4 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Chesed stabilizes Earth’s domain. The Sun in Capricorn emphasizes its organized center; Power concerns the capacity of a material structure to hold together.

name: 5 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Geburah tests material stability. Mercury in Taurus brings calculation to fixed resources, making Worry a response to pressure on what sustains the structure.

name: 6 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Tiphareth brings Earth into proportion. The Moon in Taurus suggests a receptive, sustaining material condition, supporting the title Success.

name: 7 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Netzach seeks continued growth in Earth. Saturn in Taurus constrains its yield, making Failure a question of results falling short of the desired increase.

name: 8 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Hod organizes Earth through detail and method. The Sun in Virgo emphasizes attentive cultivation, explaining Prudence as practical discrimination.

name: 9 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Yesod consolidates Earth’s productive pattern. Venus in Virgo refines and cultivates its results, suggesting Gain from sustained attention.

name: 10 of Disks
version: GD decans; separately labeled GD and Thoth titles
synthesis: Malkuth completes Earth in its own field. Mercury in Virgo organizes the accumulated result, explaining Wealth as a system of material resources rather than a promise of money.
